headlines.text: Flash back to 2026, when Ciampa, Davis & Wayne made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.22.
It was 2026 when Konosuke Takeshita vs. The Beast Mortos closed out Collision, rated 6.24.
That Saturday in 2026, it was the first-ever encounter between The Gunns and Brodido on Collision, rated 6.05.
